lagna_lord.text: Sun is in the 5th house (Putra bhav) in Sagittarius. This house covers children, intelligence, learning, mantra, creativity, past-life merit, speculation. It is a trikona (trine: 1/5/9) – the most auspicious houses, of merit and luck. Sun is in a friend's sign – supported, gives fair results. For your Leo ascendant it rules house 1 (self), so those matters are carried into the 5th house. It is a functional benefic for this ascendant. Conjunct (yuti) with Mercury. It aspects house 11. Nakshatra Mula (pada 4, ruled by Ketu).

doshas.text: Mercury is combust (too close to the Sun)

overview.text: Leo ascendant, Moon in Leo in Purva Phalguni nakshatra. The lagna lord Sun sits in the 5th house, so life's direction is tied to children, intelligence, learning, mantra, creativity, past-life merit, speculation. Most supportive planets: Sun, Mars, Moon; planets that need care: Rahu, Saturn, Jupiter.

method: From each dasha lord's houses owned and occupied, karakatva, functional nature and strength (BPHS, PVR); transits from the Moon (Phaladeepika).
disclaimer: Astrological readings describe tendencies, not certainties; make decisions with your own judgement and expert advice.

prologue: When you were born on 27 December 1980, Leo was rising on the eastern horizon. This ascendant makes you warm, proud and generous, born to shine, to lead and to be seen doing the right thing.
The Moon stood in Leo, in the nakshatra Purva Phalguni, so your mind is proud and big-hearted.
The thread that runs through your story is the ascendant's lord, Sun, sitting in the 5th house – again and again life returns to children, learning, creativity and the merit of past lives.
Your gifts come through Sun, Mars, Moon; your lessons through Rahu, Saturn, Jupiter.
The chart carries Ascendant Lord in 5th House, Sunapha Yoga, Budhaditya Yoga, Yogakaraka Planet – blessings that open when the right period arrives.
It also carries a few karmic knots – Kaal Sarp dosha, Mercury is combust (too close to the Sun), Planetary war between Jupiter + Saturn – which are untied with patience and remedies.

chapters.title: The Venus years – love and comfort
paragraphs: From 1980 to 1982 (age 0–2), through childhood, Venus brings relationships, beauty, comfort, vehicles and the pleasures of life. Venus sits in your 4th house, so this chapter was above all about home, mother, property and peace of mind; and because it rules your 3rd and 10th houses, courage, effort, siblings and your own initiatives as well as career, status and your work in the world were part of the story too.
It was a mixed chapter – life gives with one hand and tests with the other; judgement and balance are the key.
The brightest stretch was 1981–1982, in the Ketu sub-period; the hardest turn 1980–1981, in the Mercury sub-period.
Saturn's Sade Sati fell in your early childhood (age 0–1.8) – a time when the family carried extra weight and responsibility.

chapters.title: The Sun years – stepping into the light
paragraphs: From 1982 to 1988 (age 2–8), through childhood, the Sun asks you to stand on your own, to be recognised and to take responsibility. Sun sits in your 5th house, so this chapter was above all about children, learning, creativity and the merit of past lives; and because it rules your 1st house, your own body, health and sense of who you are were part of the story too.
It was one of the brightest chapters of your life – Sun is strong and well-placed for you, so effort pays and doors open.
The brightest stretch was 1983–1984, in the Mars sub-period; the hardest turn 1984, in the Rahu sub-period.

chapters.title: The Moon years – the life of the heart
paragraphs: From 1988 to 1998 (age 8–18), through youth and education, the Moon turns life towards feelings, family, mother and the people around you. Moon sits in your 1st house, so this chapter was above all about your own body, health and sense of who you are; and because it rules your 12th house, expenses, distant lands, rest and the spiritual life were part of the story too.
It was one of the brightest chapters of your life – Moon is strong and well-placed for you, so effort pays and doors open.
The brightest stretch was 1998, in the Sun sub-period; the hardest turn 1990–1991, in the Rahu sub-period.
In 1989–1990 (the Mars sub-period) the chart showed openings for studies and qualifications. Around 12, Jupiter's return opened a new twelve-year cycle of growth.

chapters.title: The Mars years – courage and building
paragraphs: From 1998 to 2005 (age 18–25), through youth and education, Mars brings energy, competition and the drive to build, fight for and own things. Mars sits in your 6th house, so this chapter was above all about work, service, rivals, debts and health battles; and because it rules your 4th and 9th houses, home, mother, property and peace of mind as well as luck, father, teachers, faith and long journeys were part of the story too.
It was one of the brightest chapters of your life – Mars is strong and well-placed for you, so effort pays and doors open.
The brightest stretch was 1998–1999, in the Mars sub-period; the hardest turn 2002–2003, in the Mercury sub-period.

In 1998–1999 (the Mars sub-period) the chart showed openings for studies and qualifications. In 2000–2001 (the Jupiter sub-period) the chart showed openings for savings and family wealth growing. In 2001–2002 (the Saturn sub-period) the chart showed openings for marriage or a committed partnership. Around 24, Jupiter's return opened a new twelve-year cycle of growth. Saturn's Sade Sati, at age 23.7–31.6, brought weight, responsibility and a demand to grow up.

chapters.title: The Rahu years – hunger and the unknown
paragraphs: From 2005 to 2023 (age 25–43), through the building years, Rahu brings big ambitions, foreign or unusual paths, sudden rises and restless confusion. Rahu sits in your 12th house, so this chapter was above all about expenses, distant lands, rest and the spiritual life.
It was a testing chapter – Rahu is under strain in your chart, so obstacles, delays or sudden change come; yet this is also when the deepest lessons and inner strength are earned.
The brightest stretch was 2022–2023, in the Mars sub-period; the hardest turn 2013–2016, in the Mercury sub-period.

Around 29, Saturn returned to its birth position and asked you to rebuild the structure of your life. Around 36, Jupiter's return opened a new twelve-year cycle of growth. In 2021–2022 (the Moon sub-period) the chart showed openings for travel or settling abroad. In 2022–2023 (the Mars sub-period) the chart showed openings for home, land or a vehicle.

chapters.title: The Jupiter years – growth and grace
paragraphs: From 2023 to 2039 (age 43–59), through maturity, Jupiter brings growth, teachers, children, wisdom and the sense of being guided. Jupiter sits in your 2nd house, so this chapter is above all about money, family and the power of your words; and because it rules your 5th and 8th houses, children, learning, creativity and the merit of past lives as well as sudden change, hidden matters, inheritance and inner transformation are part of the story too.
It is a mixed chapter – life gives with one hand and tests with the other; judgement and balance are the key.
The brightest stretch is 2034–2035, in the Sun sub-period; the hardest turn 2037–2039, in the Rahu sub-period.

Around 47, Jupiter's return will open a new twelve-year cycle of growth. In 2028–2030 (the Mercury sub-period) the chart shows openings for savings and family wealth growing. Saturn's Sade Sati, at age 53.5–60.7, will bring weight, responsibility and a demand to slow down and simplify. In 2036–2037 (the Mars sub-period) the chart shows openings for home, land or a vehicle. Around 58, Saturn will return to its birth position and ask you to rebuild the structure of your life. Around 59, Jupiter's return will open a new twelve-year cycle of growth.
You are in the middle of this chapter now – the Saturn sub-period runs until 2028-07, asking attention for wealth, savings, family.

chapters.title: The Saturn years – the long work
paragraphs: From 2039 to 2058 (age 59–78), through the elder years, Saturn brings duty, hard work, patience and results that come slowly but last. Saturn sits in your 2nd house, so this chapter will be above all about money, family and the power of your words; and because it rules your 6th and 7th houses, work, service, rivals, debts and health battles as well as marriage, partners and dealings with others will be part of the story too.
It will be a testing chapter – Saturn is under strain in your chart, so obstacles, delays or sudden change come; yet this is also when the deepest lessons and inner strength are earned.
The brightest stretch will be 2049–2050, in the Sun sub-period; the hardest turn 2053–2056, in the Rahu sub-period.

In 2042–2045 (the Mercury sub-period) the chart shows openings for savings and family wealth growing. Around 71, Jupiter's return will open a new twelve-year cycle of growth. In 2052–2053 (the Mars sub-period) the chart shows openings for home, land or a vehicle.

chapters.title: The Mercury years – learning and connecting
paragraphs: From 2058 to 2075 (age 78–95), through the years of wisdom, Mercury brings study, trade, writing, talking and a widening circle of contacts. Mercury sits in your 5th house, so this chapter will be above all about children, learning, creativity and the merit of past lives; and because it rules your 2nd and 11th houses, money, family and the power of your words as well as gains, income, friends and wishes fulfilled will be part of the story too.
It will be a mixed chapter – life gives with one hand and tests with the other; judgement and balance are the key.
The brightest stretch will be 2065, in the Sun sub-period; the hardest turn 2068–2070, in the Rahu sub-period.

Saturn's Sade Sati, at age 82.7–89.9, will bring weight, responsibility and a demand to slow down and simplify. Around 83, Jupiter's return will open a new twelve-year cycle of growth. Around 88, Saturn will return to its birth position and ask you to rebuild the structure of your life. In 2070–2073 (the Jupiter sub-period) the chart shows openings for savings and family wealth growing.

chapters.title: The Ketu years – letting go
paragraphs: From 2075 to 2082 (age 95–102), through the years of wisdom, Ketu loosens attachments and turns you inward, towards research, spirit and what truly matters. Ketu sits in your 6th house, so this chapter will be above all about work, service, rivals, debts and health battles.
It will be a mixed chapter – life gives with one hand and tests with the other; judgement and balance are the key.
The brightest stretch will be 2078, in the Mars sub-period; the hardest turn 2081–2082, in the Mercury sub-period.

epilogue: The brightest chapters of your story belong to Sun, Moon, Mars; the deepest tests to Rahu, Saturn.
You are now in the Jupiter chapter (2023–2039).
The planets show the weather, not the destination – effort, judgement and remedies let you write each chapter better.
